title: Constant twist multiplication is the canonical scalar action
statement: Put A=k[x_0,x_1] with its total-degree grading, P=Proj A [def-sc-p1-standard], and let rho:k -> Gamma(P,O_P) be the composite sending c to C(c) in A_0, then to Gamma(Spec A_0,O) via the inverse affine global-sections isomorphism, then to Gamma(P,O_P) by the pullback of Proj.toSpecZero. Scalars act on sections by restriction along rho. For every O_P-module G, every integer n, every c in k, every proof that C(c) is homogeneous of degree zero, and every section s of G tensor O_P(n) [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], the section map of G tensor twistMul(C(c)), transported along any equality n+0=n, sends s to c*s. Coherence and finite dimensionality are not assumed.

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS(3) and proof of (5), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YS; online text read

proof.text: Compute the value of rho(c) at every point directly. Unfold Proj.toSpecZero and basicOpenToSpec; GammaSpecIso inverse naturality cancels the affine global-sections isomorphisms. The top-open isomorphism and the isomorphism D+(1)=top induce restriction maps. The remaining map is awayToSection applied to fromZeroRingHom, whose value is C(c)/1. This is the fully proved private constant_value helper.

Transport twistMul n ha from n+0 to n. Extensionality on opens, sections, and points reduces its equality with Scheme.Modules.smulHom rho(c) to commutativity of multiplication in the point localization, using constant_value. The fully proved private twist_cast_val helper removes the degree transport. This works for every integer n and every scalar, without coherence or positivity.

The private tensor_hom_ext helper composes with tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv and applies injectivity of the sheafification adjunction homEquiv. Presheaf extensionality and TensorProduct.induction_on reduce the result to pure tensors. The existing whiskerLeft_app_tmulSection and tmulSection_smul formulas then prove the private tensor_smul helper: G tensor multiplication by a global function is multiplication by that function on G tensor the module. Whisker the preceding twistMul equality, identify the arbitrary equality transport p by whiskerLeft_eqToHom and proof irrelevance, and evaluate at the top open. Restriction at top is the identity, and Module.compHom identifies multiplication by rho(c) with the stated k-action.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS proof of (5) and Tag 01M6; direct Lean implementation by J2 using GammaSpecIso naturality, pointwise twist multiplication, and the tensor-sheafification adjunction.
